_comment: The viability run: one 4 h A100 run (spec section 8, run sheet D19-D52). Paths are relative to the repo root; every key can be overridden with --set a.b=value (scripts/04_distill.py). vast/bootstrap.sh reads sources, eval_sets, teacher_root, second_root, data_root, selection and student from this file. selection_recipe is how the selection is built from sources and eval_sets (python scripts/make_selection.py --config configs/viability.json): keep train rows whose teacher-vs-second-opinion CER is <= 0.5 (reazon_small vs whisper-large-v3, galgame vs kotoba-whisper), <= 0.2 for emilia_yodas (vs Emilia's own WhisperX text), and give the monitor-only hold-outs eval_emilia (<= 0.2) and galgame (<= 0.5) the same label rules; the gate sets are never filtered. vast/launch.py refuses a selection not built with it; the trainer does not read it.The differences from the DEFAULTS in scripts/04_distill.py: early_stop is on, and the eval cadence (eval.full_every_epochs, eval.mini, eval.probe_greedy_audio_s). EVALS: a FULL eval at the end of every epoch (eval.full_every_epochs 1; an epoch = one pass over the kept train rows, 233,094 utterances / 469 h = ~1,126 steps of 1500 audio-s): teacher-forced and greedy on the COMPLETE eval sets (16,240 utterances, 24.6 h; the gate sets JSUT / CV8 / ReazonSpeech-test are 14,746 and 21.9 h of them) plus the probe (teacher-forced on its 1,500 rows, greedy on a seeded ~600 s of it for the train CER). eval.every_min 20 is only the fallback cadence for full_every_epochs null (then an eval every 20 min of loop clock, greedy on the 500-per-set subset). A MINI eval every 200 optimizer steps, never at a full-eval step: 32 seeded utterances of each gate set + 64 of the probe, teacher-forced and greedy (~16 min of audio), logged under eval/mini/ and never used by the early stop or the verdict. Every eval logs its headline numbers under summary/full/ or summary/mini/ (val CER vs the reference and vs the teacher pooled over the gate sets, train CER, val / train KL and top-1) and prints one line. COST, AN ESTIMATE (no A100 measurement yet): the batched step-0 eval of this student (students/b20x2560-d4/student_meta.json step0: 03_build_student with the same greedy_eval / teacher_forced_eval, 240 s eval batches, laptop RTX 4070; untrained, so 93 % of its greedy decodes ran to the token cap, a worst case) measured greedy RTF 0.0050 and teacher-forced RTF 0.0018 on 600 gate utterances (3,205 s of audio), so a full eval of the complete sets (24.6 h) is ~7.4 + 2.6 = ~10 min on the laptop. Expect ~5-10 min on the A100: the greedy decode loop is latency-bound, so the peak-FLOPS ratio 312/165 = 1.9 need not carry over; the first run's eval/wall_s and eval/greedy_full/rtf will say. One epoch is ~47 min at the smoke floor of 600 audio-s/s and ~12-15 min at 30-40 % MFU (0.82 s per step at 30 %), so a full eval every epoch adds ~10-20 % (slow) to ~40-80 % (fast) of an epoch's training time and leaves room for ~4 (slow) to ~10-14 (fast) epoch-end evals in the 4 h loop. A mini eval (160 utterances, ~16 min of audio) costs ~5-7 s batched per 200 steps (~2-8 min of training). The early stop: when the gate sets' pooled held-out KL (the verdict's) has not improved by 0.5 % relative for 3 in-loop (epoch-end) evals in a row (never before the 3rd eval after step 0), the WSD cooldown starts at once over 20 % of the loop time done so far (capped by the budget) and the run ends when it is over, instead of training on at a flat loss until the scheduled cooldown; already in the cooldown, the run goes on to its end. To stop by hand: touch runs/<run_id>/STOP (the end phase follows the step under way).
